Open 24/7 for Emergencies & Urgent Care
At Animal Emergency & Referral Center of Minnesota (AERC), pets have been part of our story since 1980—and so have the people who love them. As a locally owned emergency and specialty veterinary practice serving the Twin Cities metro, we’re honored to care for pets of all kinds—and the people who love them—through both everyday moments and life’s unexpected turns.
Whether it’s a late-night emergency or a referral to one of our
board-certified specialists
, everything your pet needs is under one roof—and delivered by a team that treats them like their own.
24/7 Emergency Services
If you have an emergency with your pet, please call us, review our emergency and urgent care page, or drive directly to one of our two locations.
Call Oakdale: (651) 501-3766
Call St. Paul: (651) 293-1800
Emergency + Specialty Care, All in One Place
We're here when it matters most.
We offer
24/7 emergency care
, and our Oakdale facility is also home to an advanced specialty center that provides a range of services, including
surgery
,
internal medicine
,
cardiology
,
oncology
, and other specialized care. That means your family veterinarian can refer you to trusted specialists without adding extra travel or transitions for your pet.
Our collaborative, in-house approach makes it easier to get answers fast—and keeps your pet surrounded by a team that’s working together on their behalf. Plus, we work closely with your family veterinarian to ensure a seamless transition of care.

Owned by Minnesota Veterinarians
Animal Emergency & Referral Center of Minnesota is an emergency and specialty veterinary hospital in Minnesota that is owned by Minnesota-licensed veterinarians that live in your community. We’re experts at providing veterinary medicine that serves our clients, their pets, and the local veterinary community.
What does local ownership mean to you?
We are your neighbors and colleagues, and we have a dedicated interest in providing outstanding quality medicine.
As a locally owned practice, we also try to support and work closely with other Minnesota businesses and state services.
We celebrate what makes Minnesota special and seek to preserve and grow those local assets.
Learn More
Serving the Twin Cities
and Beyond
We proudly serve families across the seven-county metro with emergency care—and our specialty services extend throughout Minnesota, western Wisconsin, Iowa, and the Dakotas.
If your pet needs us, we’re here.
“Everyone, from the front desk staff to the neurologist, were genuinely concerned about our dog. The care was exceptional. Great communication at anytime we needed help. ”
